model.status: Shared balanced-contrast estimate using measured bidirectional static rig calibration; aerodynamic interpretation and installation transfer remain conditional.

calibration_assumptions.tare: Original per-run stopped raw-count baselines; calibration used a fresh bare-arm tare per orientation.
calibration_assumptions.report_sign: Historical positive rig moment is opposite operator-view ACW; rotor contrast vector [1,-1,-1,1]. This is not a verified drone body +Z convention.
calibration_assumptions.transfer: Assumes unchanged wiring, sensor response and mechanical reaction path between drone tests and deadweight calibration.

validation.grouping: Both signs and all repeats of an unsigned (mass,distance) condition held out together. Fit balances direction/condition; quoted RMS averages held-out capture errors.

limits: Validate physical rotor spin/body-axis signs separately.
Static calibration is transferred to the drone installation; free-axis rotational dynamics and dynamic torque response remain unmeasured.
Calibration references were nominal weights/distances. Balanced-yaw contrasts are below the smallest nonzero reference load; calibration residual is not a total uncertainty bound.
Do not substitute individual-motor rig-reaction polynomials as independently measured aerodynamic drag.
Not promoted to legacy runtime parameters.

revision.reason: Replace transferred thrust-cell gradient/assumed 30 mm arms with measured separate torque-channel gains, then refit from counts; no single global rescaling.

ctbr_use: Use magnitude kQ/effective armed kT for symmetric virtual-rotor yaw headroom; retain existing signed body allocation. Differential thrust equivalence and free-flight mixer dynamics remain assumptions.
